    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full singleton-colored columns are vertical dividers. Rows with one

    vlines = []
    for c in range(w):
        counts = Counter(row[c] for row in grid)
        color, n = counts.most_common(1)[0]
        if n >= h - 1 and color != Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]:
            vlines.append((c, color))
    hlines = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        counts = Counter(row)
        color, n = counts.most_common(1)[0]
        if n >= w - 3:
            hlines.append((r, color))
    rbounds = [-1] + [r for r, _ in hlines] + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + [c for c, _ in vlines] + [w]
    rsegments = [(0 if a == -1 else a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(rbounds, rbounds[1:])]
    csegments = [(0 if a == -1 else a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(cbounds, cbounds[1:])]
    out = []
    for i, (ra, rb) in enumerate(rsegments):
        outrow = []
        for j, (ca, cb) in enumerate(csegments):

            if j < len(vlines): outrow.append(vlines[j][1])
        out.append(outrow)
        if i < len(hlines): out.append([hlines[i][1]] * len(outrow))

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Dividers are color-coded full-length paths. Collapse each repeated
    # background stripe to one sample, retaining the uninterrupted divider tracks.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    # Retain the columns/rows carrying the vertical divider colors, with
    # a single background sample between adjacent divider columns.
    vc = []
    for c in range(w):
        cnt = Counter(row[c] for row in grid)
        color, n = cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        if n >= h-1 and color != 0:
            vc.append((c, color))
    hr = []
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        cnt=Counter(row); color,n=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        if n>=w-3 and color != 0:
            hr.append((r,color))
    # Project the repeating vertical pattern to one representative cell per
    # non-divider column region, preserving any crossing divider color cells.
    cols=[]
    for i,(c,color) in enumerate(vc):
        # sample most common in strip preceding this divider
        start=0 if i==0 else vc[i-1][0]+1
        if c>start:
            cols.append((start, None))
        cols.append((c,color))
    start=vc[-1][0]+1 if vc else 0
    if start<w: cols.append((start,None))
    rows=[]
    for i,(r,color) in enumerate(hr):
        start=0 if i==0 else hr[i-1][0]+1
        if r>start: rows.append((start,None))
        rows.append((r,color))
    start=hr[-1][0]+1 if hr else 0
    if start<h: rows.append((start,None))
    out=[]
    for rr,rc in rows:
        line=[]
        for cc,ccol in cols:
            if rc is not None and ccol is not None: val=grid[rr][cc]
            elif rc is not None: val=rc
            elif ccol is not None: val=ccol
            else: val=grid[rr][cc]
            line.append(val)
        out.append(line)
    return out
"
